name: TAU1: is the irreversibility threshold tau a sensitive choice, and where would label-free calibrations put it? (offline, CPU)
registered: 2026-10-29 00:30 EDT, user request 2026-10-28/29 ('run the offline tau test with all three variants'); before computing any of the statistics below. The CF3 / IRRM1 rows (per-decision, 64-draw 0.8 s undo-test residuals r8) and their grading at tau = 1.3356 are known (IRRM1: recall 22.3% at 0.8 s).
data: results/jenga/irrm1_rows_*.npz: 4679 fresh CF3 decisions (paired_record_s4 + paired_record_h2h2), r = max over 64 draws of the 0.8 s undo-vs-hold residual (the statistic behind the deployed margin l_irr). Episodes split in half at random (seed 20261029): CALIBRATION half (no labels used) and EVALUATION half (labels grade only).

variants.current: tau = 1.3356 (LF6: q98 of real latent change since the first frame, before the first grasp)
variants.B_pregrasp: tau_B = conformal (1 - 0.02) quantile of r over CALIBRATION decisions before the gripper first closes in their episode (proprio only): the undo test itself on moves before grasping; rank ceil((n + 1)(0.98))
variants.C_all: tau_C = conformal (1 - 0.02) quantile of r over ALL CALIBRATION decisions (no gripper information; assumes irreversible moves are rare)

grading: on the EVALUATION half at each tau: recall of pre-topple decisions (1-3 chunks ahead), share of safe-episode gripper-closed and gripper-open decisions flagged; AUC of r (threshold-free). Sweep A: tau = 1.3356 x (0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 1.0, 1.15, 1.3, 1.5) on ALL decisions.
decision_rule: ROBUST iff tau_B and tau_C are each within +-15% of 1.3356 AND on the evaluation half their recall is within 10 pp and safe gripper-closed flags within 2 pp of the current tau's. Otherwise RECALIBRATE recommended (margin + value retrain with the calibrated tau; registered separately, not run automatically).
